title: там … где, такой … какой, так … что

items: such (a), such, that/this kind/sort/type of, those/these kinds/sorts/types of, like that/this/those/these; in the negative also: no such
a kind/sort/type of, some kind/sort/type of
not great, meh, mediocre, middling, so-so
one like that/this, ones like that/this
that (including in the negative; often followed by in the negative)
That word doesn't exist. liThere's no **such** word.
For many, **this** experience (an experience **like this**) is highly unusual.
Табли́ца пока́зывает, как мы пришли́ к **тако́му** вы́воду.
The table shows how we came to **this** conclusion (a conclusion **like this**).
Here's the thing/deal. li**This** thing/deal is here. / A thing/deal **like this** is here.
Ты **тако́й** дура́к, что не понима́ешь э́того?
Are you **such** a fool that you don't understand this?
Они́ нака́пливаются до **тако́й** сте́пени, что стано́вится невозмо́жным их терпе́ть.
They accumulate to the point (to **such** an extent) that it becomes impossible to bear them.
It has, **you know**, stripes on it.
То есть, ты, наприме́р, мог непра́вильно сказа́ть, **там**: «Я зову́т».
So, for example, you could incorrectly say, **you know**, "Я зовут".
so, so much, as much, thus much
I’m not so much tired as I am hungry.

blocks.text: Further sentences, so that every pattern above is practised: from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English.

exercises.q: Татоэба: там, ___ (where) споры разгорячённей, чем два совокупляющихся в носке кролика!
exercises.prompt: Tatoeba: Where debates are hotter than two rabbits making babies in a sock!

exercises.q: ___ (what, which) осложнения могут возникнуть при такой операции?
exercises.prompt: What complications can occur with such an operation?
exercises.why: **Какие** — «какой» agrees with the noun it asks about (here: acc. pl. or nom. pl.).

exercises.prompt: Where there's a body, you'll find vultures.

exercises.q: Подразумевалось, что там, ___ (where) есть колодец, есть и жители.
exercises.prompt: The implication was that where there was a well, there were residents.
